title: Kiln Training and Agent Control Plane API
description: Request and response shapes for training, distillation, preflight estimates, embedded agents, recipes, corrections, and the adapter-library routes. Start with the entrypoint for your HTTP operation, then open only the definitions it references. Unknown-field behavior is listed per shape. Preflight compatibility and capacity values are modeled estimates, and the library routes do not yet perform remote installs or uploads.

AdvantageMode.description: Method used to normalize rewards within each rollout group.

AgentRunAbortResponse.description: Acknowledgment that a cooperative abort was requested.

AgentRunEventsResponse.description: Incremental event page with sequence information that lets clients detect truncated history.

AgentRunListResponse.description: Embedded agent runs Kiln currently retains.

AgentRunQueuedResponse.description: Acknowledgment that a steering or follow-up message was queued for delivery.

AgentRunRecord.description: Stored metadata and outcome for one embedded agent run.

AgentRunsStatusResponse.description: Whether embedded runs are enabled, whether the local `pi` executable is available, and current concurrency.

AgentTrace.description: Indexed `pi` session and its normalized training trajectory.

AgentTracesListResponse.description: All agent traces currently indexed by Kiln.

AgenticGroup.description: One prompt and its scored rollouts. `rollouts` is an input alias for `completions`; send exactly one of them.

BehaviorPolicy.description: Whether training uses no importance correction or the probabilities recorded during rollout generation.

message.const: stop requested — the trainer aborts at the next step boundary

CancelTrainingJobResponse.description: Cancellation result. Queued jobs stop immediately; running jobs stop cooperatively at the next training-step boundary and later appear as failed with a cancellation error.

CapacityRequest.description: Inputs to the preflight capacity model. `num_layers` and `hidden_size` default to Qwen3.5-4B values when omitted, so send both for any other model.

CapacityResponse.description: Modeled capacity estimate and any preflight warnings. This is not a measured performance result.

ClearCorrectionsResponse.description: Number of active corrections removed. Previously trained history remains.

CompatibilityResponse.description: Filtered rows from Kiln's small, model-specific built-in estimate table.

CompatibilityRow.description: One built-in teacher, student, and domain estimate. Values are modeled planning inputs, not benchmark measurements or compatibility guarantees.

CorrectionRow.description: One stored correction returned by Kiln.

CorrectionRowInput.description: Create or update one correction. Kiln can supply timestamps and training markers when they are omitted.

CreateRunRequest.description: Request to queue one embedded agent run.

DecimalU64.description: An unsigned 64-bit integer encoded as decimal text to preserve exact values.

DeleteCorrectionResponse.description: Confirmation that one correction was deleted.

DeleteTrainingJobResponse.description: Result of permanently deleting a terminal job from memory and, when present, its archive file. Active jobs must be cancelled first.

DiscoverRequest.description: Optional `pi` sessions directory on the Kiln server.

DiscoverResponse.description: Number of traces indexed and the server-local directory scanned.

DistillMergeRequest.description: Request to distill behavior from one or more source adapters into a new adapter.

DistillMergeSource.description: One source adapter and its optional merge weight.

DistillPumpMode.description: Choose a named domain, inline examples, or the built-in wide-corpus mode for knowledge pumping.

DistillPumpRequest.description: Knowledge-pump request with a registered teacher alias and a rollout budget.

DistillRefreshRequest.description: Two-phase request for learning new material and recovering instruction-following behavior. Automatic loading supports at most one gate across `post_eval`, `if_eval_suite`, and `new_knowledge_eval_suite`; disable `config.auto_load` for independent multi-suite diagnostics.

DistillSelfRequest.description: Self-distillation request that uses information available only during training.

EchoConfig.description: Settings for ECHO's observation-token auxiliary objective.

EnvMaskMode.description: Which observation tokens contribute to the ECHO auxiliary objective.

ExamplesSource.description: Either a registered dataset name or inline examples for an SFT recipe step.

FrontDoorRequest.description: Tagged request accepted by the shared `/v1/train` endpoint for all supported training workflows.

FrontDoorResponse.description: Training workflow selected by Kiln and the resulting queue receipt.

GrpoConfig.description: Complete GRPO optimizer, policy, filtering, checkpoint, and composite-loss configuration.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: recorded behavior policy requires provenance on every rollout
dataset_split requires a registered named dataset and defaults to train
GrpoRequest.description: GRPO submission using exactly one inline, local-path, or registered-dataset source.

JudgeDistillRequest.description: Request to distill a local judge from indexed agent traces.

JudgeDistillResponse.description: Queue receipt for a judge-distillation request.

JudgeDriftCheckRequest.description: Inputs accepted by the judge-drift route. After validation, the endpoint currently returns HTTP 501 and performs no drift check.

KlEstimator.description: Estimator used for the per-token KL penalty.

KlReferencePolicy.description: Reference-policy strategy used only to calculate the KL penalty.

LibraryAdapterEntry.description: One adapter entry in the configured library catalog.

LibraryListResponse.description: Configured library URL and catalog response. The current endpoint returns an empty list because remote catalog access is not operational.

ListResponse.description: Corrections from the active set or training history.

LossAggregation.description: Whether Kiln aggregates the GRPO objective by completion or by token.

LossConfig.description: GRPO objective settings. ECHO is supported; `loss.opd` is reserved and currently rejects the request.

MarkTrainedRequest.description: Mark selected corrections as used to train a named adapter.

MarkTrainedResponse.description: Number of corrections marked as trained.

MessageRequest.description: Steering or follow-up message for an active run.

NewKnowledgeSource.description: Either a registered dataset name or inline prompts for a refresh workflow.

NonEmptyString.description: A text string containing at least one character.

NonNegativeInteger.description: A whole number greater than or equal to zero.

OpdAuxConfig.description: Reserved GRPO auxiliary-objective shape. Supplying `loss.opd` currently rejects the request; use `/v1/train/opd` instead.

OpdConfig.description: OPD rollout, objective, optimizer, checkpoint, and optional ECHO settings. The semantic constraints list values the server currently accepts.

OpdLossGranularity.description: Amount of teacher-distribution data used by OPD. The server currently executes only `teacher_top_k`.

OpdObjective.description: OPD objective. `cross_entropy` is parsed for compatibility but rejected by the server.

OpdPrompt.description: Student-visible prompt with optional teacher-only context and an optional agent trajectory to replay.

OpdRequest.description: Direct OPD submission using either inline prompts or a replay dataset path on the server.

OpdRolloutPromptRendering.description: How Kiln constructs the student rollout prefix. `chat_template` is experimental.

OpdTrainingMode.description: Whether OPD generates fresh student rollouts or replays teacher-authored data.

Optimizer.description: Optimizer selection and the settings accepted by each optimizer. Unknown optimizer settings are rejected.

PositiveInteger.description: A whole number greater than or equal to one.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: train-set-eval is diagnostic only and cannot set min_accuracy
PostEvalConfig.description: Optional evaluation after training. A minimum accuracy can prevent automatic adapter loading when the candidate misses the gate.

PostEvalDataScope.description: Whether post-training evaluation is held out or an explicit train-set diagnostic.

PostEvalGateEvidence.description: Stored paired-test and confidence-interval evidence for one post-training promotion decision.

PromptsSource.description: Either a registered dataset name or inline prompts for an OPD recipe step.

PublishPayload.description: Optional description and uploader label for a future library publication.

PublishToLibraryResponse.description: Result of validating that a local adapter has the receipt required for publication. No remote upload occurs.

QueueResponse.description: Training jobs grouped into running, queued, and terminal collections.

QueueStatusEntry.description: One queued training job and its first-in, first-out position.

Recipe.description: A named, inline sequence of training and post-evaluation steps.

RecipeAdmissionDescriptor.description: Whether the current server can run a built-in recipe and, if not, why.

RecipeDescriptor.description: Summary of one built-in recipe and its current availability.

RecipeRunRequest.description: Run either a built-in recipe by name or an inline recipe body, with optional placeholder values.

RecipeRunResponse.description: Jobs and effective seeds queued for one recipe run.

RecipeStep.description: One training or post-evaluation step in a recipe.

RecipesListResponse.description: All built-in recipes and whether the current server can run each one.

RewardFilterOnEmpty.description: What to do when reward-variance filtering retains too few groups.

RunStatus.description: Lifecycle state for an embedded agent run.

ScoredRollout.description: One rewarded completion with optional trajectory and exact generation provenance.

SelfDistillMode.description: Self-distillation strategy for using information available only during training.

SelfImproveRequest.description: Request to queue the phases of one agent self-improvement round.

SelfImproveResponse.description: Job IDs and seeds queued for one self-improvement round.

SftConfig.description: Native SFT settings. Omitted fields use server defaults; unknown fields reject the request.

SftExample.description: One conversation submitted for supervised fine-tuning.

SftInvalidRowPolicy.description: Whether a malformed dataset row rejects the request or is skipped.

x-kiln-semantic-constraints: dataset_split requires a registered named dataset and defaults to train
SftRequest.description: SFT submission using exactly one inline, local-path, or registered-dataset source.

SftTrainingProfile.description: Versioned identifier for the native SFT workflow.

Sha256.description: A lowercase SHA-256 digest prefixed with `sha256:`.

StableOpdMode.description: Stable-OPD setting. Only `off` is currently executable.

TerminalStatusResponse.description: Embedded-terminal security status, local `pi` path, working directory, and session state.

TierDefaults.description: Built-in planning defaults for a coarse deployment tier. Tier names are presets, not hardware detection, measured performance classes, or device-specific tuning.

TierDefaultsResponse.description: One requested preset and its built-in planning defaults.

TraceOutcome.description: Outcome signals inferred from a `pi` session. These values are best-effort observations, not verified success criteria.

TrainingChatMessageInput.description: A chat message accepted by training endpoints. `content` may be text, null, or a structured content-parts array; structured arrays are converted to text before training.

TrainingChatMessageOutput.description: A normalized chat message returned by Kiln.

TrainingCheckpointSummary.description: Summary of the newest checkpoint whose manifest is valid and can be resumed.

TrainingDataProvenance.description: Dataset and split identity recorded when Kiln accepts the training request.

TrainingJobDetail.description: Detailed job status with its loss curve, receipts, replay request, linked evals, and newest checkpoint.

TrainingJobType.description: Training pipeline used by the job.

TrainingKind.description: Training workflow recorded in a checkpoint.

TrainingLossSample.description: One retained sample from the live training-loss curve.

TrainingResponse.description: Receipt returned after Kiln validates and queues a training request.

TrainingState.description: Training-job lifecycle state. Cancelled jobs are represented as `failed` with a cancellation error.

TrainingStatus.description: Current or archived status for one training job.

TurnSegmentInput.description: One context, model-action, or environment-observation segment accepted by training.

TurnSegmentOutput.description: One normalized trajectory segment returned by Kiln.

Vec_TrainingStatus.description: All training statuses Kiln currently retains.

CancelTrainingJobResponse.message: stop requested — the trainer aborts at the next step boundary

PublishToLibraryResponse.note: Local validation passed; no remote upload occurred.
